name: decompress
description: Secure archive extraction for Node.js monorepo
author: umar0x <hello@umar.ac>

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @umar0x/decompress && npm run build --workspace @umar0x/decompress-compatible && npm run build --workspace @umar0x/decompress-cli
scripts.pretest: npm run build --workspace @umar0x/decompress && npm run build --workspace @umar0x/decompress-compatible && npm run build --workspace @umar0x/decompress-cli
scripts.coverage: c8 --all --include packages/core/src/**/*.ts --exclude packages/core/src/**/*.d.ts --check-coverage --lines 85 --statements 85 --functions 90 --branches 80 --reporter=text --reporter=lcov node scripts/run-tests.mjs core spec
scripts.release:check: npm run verify:release && npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test:nobuild && npm run coverage && npm run test:pack:nobuild && npm audit --audit-level=low
scripts.release: npm run release:check && npm run publish:packages
scripts.publish:packages: npm publish --workspace @umar0x/decompress --access public --provenance && npm publish --workspace @umar0x/decompress-compatible --access public --provenance && npm publish --workspace @umar0x/decompress-cli --access public --provenance
